description: DC-HVAC-DT23: Data Center Cooling Telemetry and Probabilistic Surrogate Rollout Dataset is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Stanislav Polyakov, Vasilii Borisov. "A real dataset collected from an experimental HVAC set-up of an industrial data center, recorded under normal (fault-free) operation and intended for the development and benchmarking of data-driven digital twins of data center cooling systems (by \"DATARK\" LLC and \"DATCHECK\" LLC).The experimental testbed reproduces a single server-rack footprint inside a thermally contained hot\/cold-aisle enclosure. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support communication-network and digital-infrastructure studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
